notes.title: V1.01 available now. Bug fixes.
notes.content:
[h1]Fixed several common bugs reported by players.[/h1]

[h2]Notable bugs include:[/h2]
[list]
[*] removed softlock in 2-1
[*] removed softlock in 3-1
[*] fixed certain object casuing the player to start levitating
[*] removed soft lock in final level
[*] ajusted camera sensitivity to make it less sensitive
[/list]

Other smaller bugs fixed as well.
